# Versions of: A galaxy of agents

1 published version of [A galaxy of agents: the Universe we showed at Web Summit, a live 3D solar system of the RiskMandate team where people are suns, their agents orbit them and their messages travel between them as arcs of light, read from the repositories as it happens, with each agent's behaviour policy one click away, and Gravity, the library it became, which can draw any system the same way](../a-galaxy-of-agents.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
